## Date and time arithmetic

SELECT DATE_SUB(DATE '2024-03-01', INTERVAL 1 DAY)
=> "2024-02-29"

SELECT FORMAT_DATETIME('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S', DATETIME_ADD(DATETIME '2024-01-01 00:00:00', INTERVAL 90
  MINUTE))
=> "2024-01-01 01:30:00"

SELECT FORMAT_TIMESTAMP('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S', TIMESTAMP_SUB(TIMESTAMP '2024-01-01 00:00:00', INTERVAL
  1 HOUR))
=> "2023-12-31 23:00:00"

SELECT CAST(TIME_ADD(TIME '10:00:00', INTERVAL 1 HOUR) AS STRING)
=> "11:00:00"

SELECT CAST(TIME_SUB(TIME '10:00:00', INTERVAL 30 MINUTE) AS STRING)
=> "09:30:00"

SELECT FORMAT_DATETIME('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S', DATETIME_SUB(DATETIME '2024-01-01 00:00:00', INTERVAL 1
  SECOND))
=> "2023-12-31 23:59:59"

# Adding a month to the last day of a month gives the last day of the shorter month.
SELECT CAST(DATE_ADD(DATE '2024-01-31', INTERVAL 1 MONTH) AS STRING)
=> "2024-02-29"

SELECT FORMAT_TIMESTAMP('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S', TIMESTAMP_ADD(TIMESTAMP '2020-01-01 00:00:00', INTERVAL
  90 MINUTE))
=> "2020-01-01 01:30:00"

# A result outside the type's range fails, and is NULL under SAFE; GoogleSQL's compliance test
# data, functions_testlib_timestamp.cc.
SELECT DATE_ADD(DATE '9999-01-01', INTERVAL 1 YEAR)
=> error:

SELECT SAFE.DATE_ADD(DATE '9999-01-01', INTERVAL 1 YEAR)
=> null

SELECT DATE_SUB(DATE '9999-01-01', INTERVAL 9999 YEAR)
=> error:

SELECT CAST(DATE_SUB(DATE '9999-01-01', INTERVAL 9998 YEAR) AS STRING)
=> "0001-01-01"

SELECT DATETIME_ADD(DATETIME '9999-12-31 23:59:59.999999', INTERVAL 1 MICROSECOND)
=> error:

SELECT DATETIME_ADD(DATETIME '0001-01-01 00:00:00', INTERVAL -1 DAY)
=> error:

SELECT CAST(DATETIME_ADD(DATETIME '9999-12-31 23:59:59.999999', INTERVAL 0 DAY) AS STRING)
=> "9999-12-31 23:59:59.999999"

SELECT TIMESTAMP_ADD(TIMESTAMP '9999-12-28 00:00:00 UTC', INTERVAL 5 DAY)
=> error:

SELECT SAFE.TIMESTAMP_ADD(TIMESTAMP '9999-12-28 00:00:00 UTC', INTERVAL 5 DAY)
=> null

SELECT TIMESTAMP_ADD(TIMESTAMP '9999-12-31 23:59:59.999999 UTC', INTERVAL 1 MICROSECOND)
=> error:

SELECT TIMESTAMP_SUB(TIMESTAMP '0001-01-01 00:00:00 UTC', INTERVAL 1 MICROSECOND)
=> error:

SELECT FORMAT_TIMESTAMP('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S', TIMESTAMP_ADD(TIMESTAMP '9999-12-27 23:59:00 UTC',
  INTERVAL 4 DAY))
=> "9999-12-31 23:59:00"

## Date part functions

SELECT TIMESTAMP_DIFF(TIMESTAMP '2024-01-02 00:00:00', TIMESTAMP '2024-01-01 00:00:00', HOUR)
=> "24"

SELECT DATETIME_DIFF(DATETIME '2024-01-01 00:01:00', DATETIME '2024-01-01 00:00:00', SECOND)
=> "60"

SELECT TIME_DIFF(TIME '11:00:00', TIME '10:00:00', MINUTE)
=> "60"

SELECT FORMAT_DATETIME('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S', DATETIME_TRUNC(DATETIME '2024-05-17 10:20:30', HOUR))
=> "2024-05-17 10:00:00"

SELECT FORMAT_TIMESTAMP('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S', TIMESTAMP_TRUNC(TIMESTAMP '2024-05-17 10:20:30', DAY))
=> "2024-05-17 00:00:00"

SELECT DATE_DIFF(DATE '2024-03-01', DATE '2024-01-01', DAY)
=> "60"

SELECT DATE_DIFF(DATE '2024-01-01', DATE '2024-03-01', MONTH)
=> "-2"

SELECT CAST(DATE_TRUNC(DATE '2024-05-17', MONTH) AS STRING)
=> "2024-05-01"

## Epoch conversions

SELECT UNIX_MICROS(TIMESTAMP '2020-01-01 00:00:00')
=> "1577836800000000"

SELECT FORMAT_TIMESTAMP('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S', TIMESTAMP_SECONDS(1577836800))
=> "2020-01-01 00:00:00"

SELECT FORMAT_TIMESTAMP('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S', TIMESTAMP_MICROS(1577836800000000))
=> "2020-01-01 00:00:00"

SELECT UNIX_SECONDS(TIMESTAMP '2020-01-01 00:00:00')
=> "1577836800"

SELECT UNIX_MILLIS(TIMESTAMP '2020-01-01 00:00:00')
=> "1577836800000"

SELECT FORMAT_TIMESTAMP('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ', TIMESTAMP_MILLIS(1577836800000))
=> "2020-01-01T00:00:00Z"

SELECT CAST(DATE_FROM_UNIX_DATE(18262) AS STRING)
=> "2020-01-01"

# The conversions fail past 0001-01-01 and 9999-12-31 23:59:59.999999, and SAFE. returns NULL.
SELECT CAST(DATE_FROM_UNIX_DATE(2932896) AS STRING)
=> "9999-12-31"

SELECT CAST(DATE_FROM_UNIX_DATE(-719162) AS STRING)
=> "0001-01-01"

SELECT DATE_FROM_UNIX_DATE(2932897)
=> error:

SELECT DATE_FROM_UNIX_DATE(-719163)
=> error:

SELECT SAFE.DATE_FROM_UNIX_DATE(9223372036854775807)
=> null

SELECT FORMAT_TIMESTAMP('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%E6S', TIMESTAMP_SECONDS(253402300799))
=> "9999-12-31 23:59:59.000000"

SELECT TIMESTAMP_SECONDS(-62135596800) = TIMESTAMP '0001-01-01 00:00:00+00'
=> "true"

SELECT TIMESTAMP_SECONDS(253402300800)
=> error:

SELECT TIMESTAMP_SECONDS(-62135596801)
=> error:

SELECT SAFE.TIMESTAMP_SECONDS(9223372036854775807)
=> null

SELECT FORMAT_TIMESTAMP('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%E6S', TIMESTAMP_MILLIS(253402300799999))
=> "9999-12-31 23:59:59.999000"

SELECT TIMESTAMP_MILLIS(-62135596800000) = TIMESTAMP '0001-01-01 00:00:00+00'
=> "true"

SELECT TIMESTAMP_MILLIS(253402300800000)
=> error:

SELECT TIMESTAMP_MILLIS(-62135596800001)
=> error:

SELECT SAFE.TIMESTAMP_MILLIS(-9223372036854775808)
=> null

SELECT FORMAT_TIMESTAMP('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%E6S', TIMESTAMP_MICROS(253402300799999999))
=> "9999-12-31 23:59:59.999999"

SELECT TIMESTAMP_MICROS(-62135596800000000) = TIMESTAMP '0001-01-01 00:00:00+00'
=> "true"

SELECT TIMESTAMP_MICROS(253402300800000000)
=> error:

SELECT TIMESTAMP_MICROS(-62135596800000001)
=> error:

SELECT SAFE.TIMESTAMP_MICROS(253402300800000000)
=> null

SELECT CAST(PARSE_DATE('%Y-%m-%d', '2024-02-29') AS STRING)
=> "2024-02-29"

## Date time constructors and extract
# Weeks, sub-second parts and differences below a day are where DuckDB's date functions answer
# differently from BigQuery's.

SELECT EXTRACT(DAYOFWEEK FROM DATE '2024-01-07')
=> "1"

SELECT EXTRACT(DAYOFYEAR FROM DATE '2024-02-01')
=> "32"

SELECT EXTRACT(WEEK FROM DATE '2024-01-07')
=> "1"

SELECT EXTRACT(ISOWEEK FROM DATE '2024-01-07')
=> "1"

SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM DATETIME '2024-05-06 07:08:09')
=> "2024"

SELECT EXTRACT(MILLISECOND FROM TIMESTAMP '2024-01-01 00:00:12.345678')
=> "345"

SELECT EXTRACT(MICROSECOND FROM TIMESTAMP '2024-01-01 00:00:12.345678')
=> "345678"

SELECT EXTRACT(HOUR FROM TIMESTAMP '2024-01-01 00:00:00' AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Tokyo')
=> "9"

SELECT EXTRACT(DATE FROM TIMESTAMP '2024-01-01 20:00:00' AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Tokyo')
=> "2024-01-02"

SELECT CAST(EXTRACT(TIME FROM DATETIME '2024-01-01 01:02:03') AS STRING)
=> "01:02:03"

SELECT DATE_TRUNC(DATE '2024-01-10', WEEK)
=> "2024-01-07"

SELECT DATE_TRUNC(DATE '2024-01-10', ISOWEEK)
=> "2024-01-08"

SELECT FORMAT_DATETIME('%Y-%m-%d', DATETIME_TRUNC(DATETIME '2024-01-07 10:00:00', WEEK))
=> "2024-01-07"

SELECT DATE_DIFF(DATE '2024-01-07', DATE '2024-01-06', WEEK)
=> "1"

SELECT DATE_DIFF(DATE '2024-01-08', DATE '2024-01-07', ISOWEEK)
=> "1"

SELECT DATE_DIFF(DATE '2024-01-06', DATE '2024-01-01', WEEK)
=> "0"

SELECT TIMESTAMP_DIFF(TIMESTAMP '2001-02-01 01:00:00', TIMESTAMP '2001-02-01 00:00:01', HOUR)
=> "0"

SELECT TIMESTAMP_DIFF(TIMESTAMP '2024-01-02 01:00:00', TIMESTAMP '2024-01-01 23:00:00', DAY)
=> "0"

SELECT TIME_DIFF(TIME '09:59:00', TIME '10:00:30', MINUTE)
=> "-1"

SELECT DATETIME_DIFF(DATETIME '2024-01-02 00:00:00', DATETIME '2024-01-01 23:59:59', DAY)
=> "1"

# Unlike TIMESTAMP_DIFF, DATETIME_DIFF counts the boundaries crossed below a day too.
SELECT DATETIME_DIFF(DATETIME '2016-04-08 15:00:00', DATETIME '2016-04-08 14:59:59.123456', HOUR)
=> "1"

SELECT DATETIME_DIFF(DATETIME '2016-04-08 23:00:00', DATETIME '2016-04-08 00:59:59.123456', HOUR)
=> "23"

SELECT DATE(2024, 1, 2)
=> "2024-01-02"

SELECT DATE(TIMESTAMP '2024-01-01 20:00:00', 'Asia/Tokyo')
=> "2024-01-02"

SELECT DATE(DATETIME '2024-01-01 20:00:00')
=> "2024-01-01"

SELECT FORMAT_DATETIME('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S', DATETIME(2024, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5))
=> "2024-01-02 03:04:05"

SELECT FORMAT_DATETIME('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S', DATETIME(DATE '2024-01-02', TIME '03:04:05'))
=> "2024-01-02 03:04:05"

SELECT FORMAT_DATETIME('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S', DATETIME(TIMESTAMP '2024-01-01 00:00:00', 'Asia/Tokyo'))
=> "2024-01-01 09:00:00"

SELECT CAST(TIME(1, 2, 3) AS STRING)
=> "01:02:03"

SELECT CAST(TIME(DATETIME '2024-01-01 04:05:06') AS STRING)
=> "04:05:06"

SELECT UNIX_SECONDS(TIMESTAMP(DATETIME '2024-01-01 09:00:00', 'Asia/Tokyo'))
=> "1704067200"

SELECT UNIX_SECONDS(TIMESTAMP(DATE '2024-01-01'))
=> "1704067200"

SELECT UNIX_SECONDS(TIMESTAMP('2024-01-01 09:00:00+09'))
=> "1704067200"

SELECT FORMAT_TIMESTAMP('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S', TIMESTAMP('2008-12-25 15:30:00', 'America/Los_Angeles'))
=> "2008-12-25 23:30:00"

SELECT FORMAT_TIMESTAMP('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S', TIMESTAMP('2008-12-25 15:30:00 UTC'))
=> "2008-12-25 15:30:00"

SELECT TIMESTAMP(CAST(NULL AS STRING), 'UTC')
=> null

SELECT TIMESTAMP('2008-12-25 15:30:00', CAST(NULL AS STRING))
=> null

SELECT STRING(TIMESTAMP '2008-12-25 15:30:00+00', 'UTC')
=> "2008-12-25 15:30:00+00"

SELECT STRING(TIMESTAMP '2008-12-25 15:30:00+00')
=> "2008-12-25 15:30:00+00"

SELECT STRING(TIMESTAMP '2014-02-28 18:20:30+00', 'Asia/Kolkata')
=> "2014-02-28 23:50:30+05:30"

SELECT STRING(TIMESTAMP '2014-02-28 18:20:30+00', 'Australia/Eucla')
=> "2014-03-01 03:05:30+08:45"

SELECT STRING(TIMESTAMP '2014-02-28 18:20:30+00', 'US/Eastern')
=> "2014-02-28 13:20:30-05"

SELECT STRING(CAST(NULL AS TIMESTAMP), 'UTC')
=> null

SELECT STRING(TIMESTAMP '2008-12-25 15:30:00+00', CAST(NULL AS STRING))
=> null

SELECT LAST_DAY(DATE '2024-02-10')
=> "2024-02-29"

SELECT LAST_DAY(DATE '2024-02-10', MONTH)
=> "2024-02-29"

SELECT UNIX_DATE(DATE '2020-01-01')
=> "18262"

SELECT ARRAY_TO_STRING(ARRAY(SELECT FORMAT_DATE('%d', d) FROM UNNEST(GENERATE_DATE_ARRAY(DATE
  '2024-01-01', DATE '2024-01-15', INTERVAL 1 WEEK)) AS d), ',')
=> "01,08,15"

SELECT ARRAY_LENGTH(GENERATE_DATE_ARRAY(DATE '2024-01-01', DATE '2024-01-03'))
=> "3"

# BigQuery's documented MONTH step.
SELECT ARRAY_TO_STRING(ARRAY(SELECT CAST(d AS STRING) FROM UNNEST(GENERATE_DATE_ARRAY('2016-01-01',
  '2016-12-31', INTERVAL 2 MONTH)) AS d), ',')
=> "2016-01-01,2016-03-01,2016-05-01,2016-07-01,2016-09-01,2016-11-01"

SELECT ARRAY_TO_STRING(ARRAY(SELECT CAST(d AS STRING) FROM UNNEST(GENERATE_DATE_ARRAY(DATE
  '1970-03-17', DATE '1970-01-31', INTERVAL -1 MONTH)) AS d), ',')
=> "1970-03-17,1970-02-17"

# A step adds to the previous element, which carries a date clamped to the end of a month.
SELECT ARRAY_TO_STRING(ARRAY(SELECT CAST(d AS STRING) FROM UNNEST(GENERATE_DATE_ARRAY(DATE
  '2024-01-31', DATE '2024-05-01', INTERVAL 1 MONTH)) AS d), ',')
=> "2024-01-31,2024-02-29,2024-03-29,2024-04-29"

SELECT ARRAY_TO_STRING(ARRAY(SELECT CAST(d AS STRING) FROM UNNEST(GENERATE_DATE_ARRAY(DATE
  '2024-02-29', DATE '2028-03-01', INTERVAL 1 YEAR)) AS d), ',')
=> "2024-02-29,2025-02-28,2026-02-28,2027-02-28,2028-02-28"

SELECT ARRAY_LENGTH(GENERATE_DATE_ARRAY(DATE '1970-04-01', DATE '1970-01-11', INTERVAL 1 MONTH))
=> "0"

SELECT ARRAY_TO_STRING(ARRAY(SELECT CAST(d AS STRING) FROM UNNEST(GENERATE_DATE_ARRAY('2016-10-05',
  '2016-10-01', INTERVAL -3 DAY)) AS d), ',')
=> "2016-10-05,2016-10-02"

SELECT GENERATE_DATE_ARRAY('2016-10-05', NULL) IS NULL
=> "true"

# A step past the end of the date range stops at the start rather than failing.
SELECT ARRAY_TO_STRING(ARRAY(SELECT CAST(d AS STRING) FROM UNNEST(GENERATE_DATE_ARRAY(DATE
  '0001-01-01', DATE '9999-12-31', INTERVAL 9223372036854775807 DAY)) AS d), ',')
=> "0001-01-01"

SELECT ARRAY_TO_STRING(ARRAY(SELECT CAST(d AS STRING) FROM UNNEST(GENERATE_DATE_ARRAY(DATE
  '9999-12-31', DATE '0001-01-01', INTERVAL -9223372036854775808 DAY)) AS d), ',')
=> "9999-12-31"

SELECT ARRAY_TO_STRING(ARRAY(SELECT CAST(d AS STRING) FROM UNNEST(GENERATE_DATE_ARRAY(DATE
  '9999-12-28', DATE '9999-12-31', INTERVAL 2 DAY)) AS d), ',')
=> "9999-12-28,9999-12-30"

# BigQuery fails on a zero step and on more than 1,048,576 elements.
SELECT SAFE.GENERATE_DATE_ARRAY(DATE '2016-01-01', DATE '2017-01-01', INTERVAL 0 DAY) IS NULL
=> "true"

SELECT SAFE.GENERATE_DATE_ARRAY(DATE '0001-01-01', DATE '9999-12-31') IS NULL
=> "true"

BEGIN
  SELECT GENERATE_DATE_ARRAY(DATE '2016-01-01', DATE '2017-01-01', INTERVAL 0 DAY) IS NULL;
EXCEPTION WHEN ERROR THEN
  SELECT TRUE;
END;
=> "true"

SELECT ARRAY_TO_STRING(ARRAY(SELECT FORMAT_TIMESTAMP('%H:%M', t) FROM
  UNNEST(GENERATE_TIMESTAMP_ARRAY(TIMESTAMP '2024-01-01 00:00:00', TIMESTAMP '2024-01-01 01:00:00',
  INTERVAL 20 MINUTE)) AS t), ',')
=> "00:00,00:20,00:40,01:00"

SELECT ARRAY_LENGTH(GENERATE_TIMESTAMP_ARRAY(TIMESTAMP '2024-01-03', TIMESTAMP '2024-01-01',
  INTERVAL -1 DAY))
=> "3"

SELECT ARRAY_LENGTH(GENERATE_TIMESTAMP_ARRAY(TIMESTAMP '2024-01-03', TIMESTAMP '2024-01-01',
  INTERVAL 1 DAY))
=> "0"

SELECT GENERATE_TIMESTAMP_ARRAY(TIMESTAMP '2024-01-01', NULL, INTERVAL 1 DAY) IS NULL
=> "true"

SELECT GENERATE_TIMESTAMP_ARRAY(TIMESTAMP '2024-01-01', TIMESTAMP '2024-01-02', INTERVAL 0 DAY)
=> error:

## Buckets

# The examples of the BigQuery reference.
SELECT ARRAY_TO_STRING(ARRAY(SELECT CAST(DATE_BUCKET(d, INTERVAL 2 DAY) AS STRING) FROM UNNEST([DATE
  '1949-12-29', DATE '1949-12-30', DATE '1949-12-31', DATE '1950-01-01', DATE '1950-01-02', DATE
  '1950-01-03']) AS d), ',')
=> "1949-12-28,1949-12-30,1949-12-30,1950-01-01,1950-01-01,1950-01-03"

SELECT ARRAY_TO_STRING(ARRAY(SELECT CAST(DATE_BUCKET(d, INTERVAL 7 DAY, DATE '2000-12-24') AS
  STRING) FROM UNNEST([DATE '2000-12-20', DATE '2000-12-21', DATE '2000-12-24', DATE '2000-12-25']) AS
  d), ',')
=> "2000-12-17,2000-12-17,2000-12-24,2000-12-24"

SELECT ARRAY_TO_STRING(ARRAY(SELECT FORMAT_TIMESTAMP('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S', TIMESTAMP_BUCKET(t,
  INTERVAL 7 DAY, TIMESTAMP '2000-12-22 12:00:00')) FROM UNNEST([TIMESTAMP '2000-12-21 13:00:00',
  TIMESTAMP '2000-12-22 12:00:00', TIMESTAMP '2000-12-29 11:59:59']) AS t), ',')
=> "2000-12-15 12:00:00,2000-12-22 12:00:00,2000-12-22 12:00:00"

SELECT FORMAT_TIMESTAMP('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S', TIMESTAMP_BUCKET(TIMESTAMP '1949-12-31 13:00:00',
  INTERVAL 12 HOUR))
=> "1949-12-31 12:00:00"

SELECT CAST(DATETIME_BUCKET(DATETIME '1950-01-01 13:00:00', INTERVAL 12 HOUR) AS STRING)
=> "1950-01-01 12:00:00"

SELECT CAST(DATETIME_BUCKET(DATETIME '1950-01-01 13:00:00', INTERVAL '0:30' HOUR TO MINUTE) AS
  STRING)
=> "1950-01-01 13:00:00"

# Months count in the calendar, and last days of the month count as the same day.
SELECT ARRAY_TO_STRING(ARRAY(SELECT CAST(DATE_BUCKET(d, INTERVAL 1 QUARTER, DATE '2000-01-31') AS
  STRING) FROM UNNEST([DATE '2000-04-29', DATE '2000-04-30', DATE '1999-12-31', DATE '1999-10-30']) AS
  d), ',')
=> "2000-01-31,2000-04-30,1999-10-31,1999-07-31"

SELECT CAST(DATE_BUCKET(DATE '2024-05-20', INTERVAL 1 YEAR) AS STRING)
=> "2024-01-01"

# The bucket width must be positive.
SELECT DATE_BUCKET(DATE '2024-01-01', INTERVAL -1 DAY)
=> error:

SELECT TIMESTAMP_BUCKET(TIMESTAMP '2024-01-01', INTERVAL 0 HOUR)
=> error:
